This app has been installed to monitor this device's activity for security and transparency purposes. Once you accept, the following may be collected and shared with the account administrator:

 • Location (only when requested from the dashboard)
 • App usage and screen time
 • Website browsing history
 • SMS and call log details (number, time, duration — not content or audio)
 • Installed apps list
 • Device lock and file listing on request

 This app's icon will always remain visible on this device, and opening it shows the current monitoring status. You can contact the account administrator with any questions.

Lets the account administrator block selected apps and websites during scheduled hours, and record browsing history when that feature is turned on. Only checks which app is currently open (and, for supported browsers, the address bar) — never reads message content or other on-screen text.
This app is blocked right now
Required for Live Screen Streaming, Screen Capture, App/Website Blocking, and Web History.

To enable Live Screen Stream and Monitoring:

1. Tap "Go to Settings" below.
2. In Accessibility settings, tap "Downloaded apps" or "Installed services".
3. Select "Spapp Monitor" and turn it ON.

⚠️ On Android 13+: If the toggle is grayed out ("Restricted setting"), tap "Allow Restricted" below to open App Info -> tap 3 dots (top right) -> "Allow restricted settings", then return to turn Accessibility ON.
